reason: A Windows-focused Docker management sidebar that provides container listing, resource monitoring, and container file browsing and transfer through a WebUI panel; the README documents full-access shell execution and unauthenticated local HTTP endpoints, warranting R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 通过 WebUI 侧边栏管理 Docker 容器，提供容器列表、资源监控以及容器内文件浏览、查看、上传和下载功能。
summaries.en: Manage Docker containers from a WebUI sidebar with container listing, resource monitoring, and in-container file browsing, viewing, uploading, and downloading.

capabilities: Executes Docker commands through a full-access shell
Lists containers and retrieves container resource statistics
Browses and reads files inside containers
Downloads files from and uploads files to containers
Copies container files to a temporary directory and opens them with the system default application
Exposes local HTTP endpoints without authentication
